input:
Repo: Tendril (current directory). Task: overlap probe for entities the merge treats as 'sole owner, moves as-is'. The merged app already decided these shared schemas: ITEM (one table, kinds TASK/EVENT/REMINDER/HABIT/ACTIVITY, subtasks via parent id, recurrence as an RRULE on the item, a completion log per occurrence), REMINDER rows hanging off an item, CHECK_IN (mood/energy), TRACKER + TRACKER_READING + GOAL (Chronicle's logged values), TIME_SPAN (timed intervals), LABEL (one vocabulary), SETTINGS, one FTS search index.
For each entity below, list its columns with types, state what concept it stores, and say whether it DUPLICATES or OVERLAPS one of the decided schemas above (same idea stored twice), quoting the code that shows it. Main files are under shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/tendril/app/data/.
Claims to verify (each is a claim that the entity is independent of the decided schemas):
1. HabitBlock is a named time-of-day block used only for placing habits; it stores no recurrence and no reminder.
2. HabitScheduleEdit records a change to a habit's schedule; it is not a per-occurrence override (moved or skipped occurrence) of the kind a recurrence exception would hold.
3. CalendarLink links to the Android system calendar and stores no copy of events that would duplicate ITEM EVENT rows.
4. PageDatabase with syncToTasks turns member pages into Task entries; say which table holds the task afterwards and whether the page and the task are two rows for one thing.
5. Property and PropertyValue (Notion-like database properties) do not store dated, typed values that duplicate TRACKER_READING (a value logged at a time), nor a due date/status that duplicates a TASK.
6. PageRevision, PageRelation, PageCanvas, CanvasNode, CanvasEdge, PageDatabaseView, Block and Page are page-only concepts that duplicate none of the decided schemas.
7. Any entity above has its own tombstone/sync scheme that differs from the rest of Tendril (say which).

Repo: Chronicle (current directory). Task: overlap probe for entities the merge treats as 'sole owner, moves as-is'. The merged app already decided these shared schemas: ITEM (one table, kinds TASK/EVENT/REMINDER/HABIT/ACTIVITY, subtasks via parent id, a done status and completion log, recurrence as RRULE), REMINDER rows hanging off an item, CHECK_IN, TRACKER + TRACKER_READING + GOAL, TIME_SPAN, LABEL (one vocabulary), SETTINGS, one FTS search index.
For each entity below, list its columns with types, state what concept it stores, and say whether it DUPLICATES or OVERLAPS one of the decided schemas (same idea stored twice), quoting the code. Entities are in data/src/main/kotlin/com/hazia/chronicle/data/room/entity/.
Claims to verify:
1. ChecklistEntity and ChecklistItemEntity are a reusable checklist (a template ticked off repeatedly), not a to-do list of one-off tasks; say whether items have a done flag, a due date, an order, and whether ticks are stored per use (a history) or as a current state.
2. A checklist is not attached to a reminder, activity or tracker; report every foreign key or id reference to and from checklist tables.
3. TrackerChoiceEntity is the option list of a CHOICE tracker and nothing else.
4. SavedChartEntity stores only a chart definition (sources, range, goal) and no data values.
5. GoalEntity (targetType ACTIVITY|TRACKER, period, value, kind, completionMode, achievedAtMillis) has no overlap with a task's done state or a habit's daily amount; quote completionMode and MILESTONE semantics.

Repo: Equipoise (current directory). Task: overlap probe for entities the merge treats as 'sole owner, moves as-is'. The merged app already decided these shared schemas: ITEM (tasks, events, reminders, habits, activities; a completion log), REMINDER rows hanging off an item (scheduled notifications/alarms), CHECK_IN (mood 1-5; energy and pleasantness 0..1; source_levels; stability; note), TRACKER + TRACKER_READING (a typed value - number, yes/no, rating 1-5, choice - logged at a time, with a note) + GOAL, TIME_SPAN, LABEL, SETTINGS, search.
Entities are in app/src/main/kotlin/com/hazia/equipoise/data/db/Entities.kt. For each entity below, list its columns with types, state what concept it stores, and say whether it DUPLICATES or OVERLAPS one of the decided schemas (same idea stored twice), quoting the code.
Claims to verify:
1. SensoryLogEntity is a regulation-specific record that a generic TRACKER_READING (a typed value at a time with a note) could not hold without loss; say what columns it has beyond a timestamp, a value and a note.
2. MaskingEntryEntity is likewise regulation-specific; same question.
3. RegulationEventEntity records a regulation episode or intervention; say whether it has a start and an end (overlapping TIME_SPAN) or a scheduled follow-up.
4. PendingOutcomeEntity is a follow-up prompt scheduled for later; say whether it fires a notification at a time (overlapping a REMINDER) and how it is scheduled (AlarmManager, WorkManager, on open).
5. DailyIndexEntity is a derived daily score recomputable from other rows, not user input; say what computes it and whether it is stored or cached.
6. Which of these entities are exported/imported by Transfer.kt.
